title: The Deathray: A simple way for an untrusted site to freeze a Mac
summary: A security researcher discovered a vulnerability dubbed 'Deathray' that allows malicious websites to freeze or crash macOS browsers by exploiting computationally expensive CSS operations like backdrop-filter, effectively creating a denial-of-service attack vector against Mac users visiting untrusted sites.
problem_solved: Demonstrates a critical browser DoS vulnerability that enables any website to freeze a visitor's Mac without their consent.
why_valuable: This research exposes a serious client-side security flaw affecting Mac users and pushes for browser vendors to implement safeguards against resource-exhaustion attacks from web content.
